name: Break-Even
intro: You will work out how many sales a small business needs each month to stop losing money, using three example numbers ($25 price, $9.50 cost, $3,220 monthly bills). Then you try a few tricky numbers and check the answers stay put after a reload.

steps.do: When the app opens, a “Welcome to Break-Even” card is at the bottom. Tap the small link “skip the tour” at its bottom-right.
steps.see: The card asks “How do you want to start?” with “🧪 Keep the examples to play with” and “✨ Start fresh with my own”.
steps.tip: A green greeting may show at the top for a few seconds — it goes away by itself.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Start fresh with my own”. (If a small box asks “Start fresh? The examples will be cleared.”, tap “OK”.)
steps.see: The card closes (on a new phone the box may not come — that is fine). The three boxes are empty (they show grey hints like “e.g. 25”), the answer boxes show a dash “—”, and further down it says “Type your price in the first box to see this table.”

steps.do: Tap the first box, “AVERAGE PRICE PER SALE ($)”, and type the number below.
steps.see: The answers fill in: “YOU KEEP PER SALE” says $25.00 and “MARGIN %” says 100%. A table “IF YOUR PRICE WERE…” appears with five rows from $20.00 (-20%) to $30.00 (+20%).
steps.tip: The box shows $ — just type the numbers; read $ as shillings.

steps.do: Tap the second box, “VARIABLE COST PER SALE ($)”, and type the number below.
steps.see: “YOU KEEP PER SALE” changes to $15.50 and “MARGIN %” to 62%.
steps.tip: The box shows $ — just type the numbers; read $ as shillings.

steps.do: Tap the third box, “MONTHLY FIXED COSTS ($)”, and type the number below.
steps.see: “SALES NEEDED / MONTH” says 208 and “REVENUE NEEDED / MONTH” says $5,200.
steps.tip: The box shows $ — just type the numbers; read $ as shillings.

steps.do: Scroll down to the table “IF YOUR PRICE WERE…”.
steps.see: The row “Now · $25.00” shows 208 and $5,200. The cheaper row “$20.00 (-20%)” needs 307 sales; the dearer row “$30.00 (+20%)” needs only 158.

steps.do: Scroll back up. In the cost box, replace 9.50 with the number below (more than the price).
steps.see: The sales and revenue answers say “n/a”, and a message reads “You lose $5.00 on every sale. No number of sales breaks even. Raise the price above $30.00.”

steps.do: Change the cost box to the number below (the same as the price).
steps.see: A message says “Each sale only pays for itself, so nothing is left for your fixed costs…”. In the table only the two higher prices have answers (e.g. $27.50 needs 1,288).

steps.do: Change the cost box back to the number below.
steps.see: The warning goes away and “SALES NEEDED / MONTH” is back to 208.

steps.do: Now try a very big number: change the monthly fixed costs box to the number below.
steps.see: “SALES NEEDED / MONTH” says 64,517 and “REVENUE NEEDED / MONTH” says $1,612,925 — with commas, nothing cut off.

steps.do: Change the fixed costs box back to the number below.
Tap the price box and delete the 25 so it is empty.
steps.see: The answers go back to dashes “—” and the table says “Type your price in the first box to see this table.”

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: Your three numbers (25, 9.50, 3220) are still in the boxes and it still says 208. On an iPhone, a dark strip “Install on iPhone: tap the Share button…” and a card “Keep Break-Even Calculator on your Home Screen” may also pop up. On many Android phones they do not appear — that is fine.

steps.do: If a dark “Install on iPhone” strip appears, tap its ×. If a “Keep Break-Even Calculator on your Home Screen” card appears, tap “Later”. On many Android phones neither appears — then just go on.
steps.see: No strip or card is covering the page, and you can see your numbers.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (iPhone: swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️. Android: swipe down from the top of the screen, tap ✈️ Airplane mode). Change the cost box to the number below, then turn Airplane Mode off.
steps.see: It still works with no internet: 248 sales needed, $6,200 revenue, you keep $13.00, margin 52%.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload once more.
steps.see: The boxes show 25, 12 and 3220, and “SALES NEEDED / MONTH” still says 248 — your last numbers were kept.
